app.title: ohdo
ui_v2.onboarding.page_env_description:
ohdo runs Python automation code, so you need a Python interpreter,
required packages, and an AI CLI.

If the environment is not ready, open Settings (Ctrl+,)
and run the auto-scan from the '🔧 Environment' tab.
ui_v2.onboarding.page_engine_sub: Choose the AI engine for your first automation. You can change it later in Settings.
ui_v2.onboarding.engine_openai_compat: OpenAI-compatible API (register your key — OpenAI / DeepSeek / Groq / Ollama, etc.)
ui_v2.onboarding.page_first_sub: The selected scenario creates your first session and fills the input box automatically.
ui_v2.onboarding.scenario_notepad_prompt: Open Notepad, type 'Hello' and save with Ctrl+S
ui_v2.onboarding.scenario_browser_prompt: Open google.com in Chrome and search for 'Samsung Electronics'
ui_v2.step_card.req_edit_tooltip: Click to regenerate from this request (toast confirms)
ui_v2.step_card.ai_preview_tooltip: Click to expand/collapse the full description
ui_v2.step_card.btn_edit_tooltip: Edit code directly — click to edit, click again to save
ui_v2.validation.regenerate_hint: Click 'Regenerate' to inform the AI of these issues and regenerate from the same request.
ui_v2.chat.placeholder: Next request...  (Enter: send, Shift+Enter: newline, Ctrl+Enter: send)
ui_v2.chat.tooltip_capture: Screen capture — attach to next message
ui_v2.chat.tooltip_elempick: Pick element — add context to next message
